parameters.name: INSERTCOVIDSQL
parameters.value:
INSERT INTO `test-project-471918.DW.fact_covid_vaccination_summary` (
    app_lookup_key,
    date_key,
    county_key,
    total_doses,
    cumulative_total_doses,
    partially_vaccinated,
    total_partially_vaccinated,
    fully_vaccinated,
    cumulative_fully_vaccinated,
    at_least_one_dose,
    cumulative_at_least_one_dose,
    california_flag,
    up_to_date_count,
    cumulative_up_to_date_count
)
SELECT
${app_id} AS app_loolkup_key,
    d.date_key,
    c.county_key,
    ${TOTAL_DOSES} AS total_doses,
    ${CUMULATIVE_TOTAL_DOSES}  AS cumulative_total_doses,
    ${PARTIALLY_VACCINATED} AS partially_vaccinated,
     ${TOTAL_PARTIALLY_VACCINATED} AS total_partially_vaccinated,
     ${FULLY_VACCINATED}  AS fully_vaccinated,
     ${CUMULATIVE_FULLY_VACCINATED} AS cumulative_fully_vaccinated,
    ${AT_LEAST_ONE_DOSE} AS at_least_one_dose,
   ${CUMULATIVE_AT_LEAST_ONE_DOSE} AS cumulative_at_least_one_dose,
   ${CALIFORNIA_FLAG} AS california_flag,
   ${UP_TO_DATE_COUNT} AS up_to_date_count,
   ${CUMULATIVE_UP_TO_DATE_COUNT} AS cumulative_up_to_date_count
FROM `test-project-471918.DW.dim_date` AS d
JOIN `test-project-471918.DW.dim_county` AS c
  ON c.county_name = '${COUNTY}'
WHERE d.full_date=DATE(TIMESTAMP('${ADMINISTERED_DATE}'));

parameters.name: INSERTRESPSQL
parameters.value:
INSERT INTO `test-project-471918.DW.fact_respiratory_metrics` (
    app_lookup_key,
    date_key,
    region_key,
    age_group_key,
    season_key,
    cov_positives,
    cov_total_tests,
    cov_tp,
    cov_tp_level,
    flu_positives,
    flu_total_tests,
    flu_tp,
    flu_tp_level,
    rsv_positives,
    rsv_total_tests,
    rsv_tp,
    rsv_tp_level,
    cov_ed_visits,
    flu_ed_visits,
    rsv_ed_visits,
    population,
    cov_adm,
    flu_adm,
    rsv_adm,
    cov_adm_rate,
    flu_adm_rate,
    rsv_adm_rate,
    cov_adm_level,
    flu_adm_level,
    rsv_adm_level,
    total_deaths,
    cov_deaths,
    flu_deaths,
    rsv_deaths,
    cov_deaths_per,
    flu_deaths_per,
    rsv_deaths_per,
    season_cov_ped_deaths,
    season_flu_ped_deaths,
    season_rsv_ped_deaths,
    flu_a_tests,
    flu_b_tests
)
SELECT
${app_id} AS app_loolkup_key,
    d.date_key,
    r.region_key,
    a.age_group_key,
    s.season_key,
    ${cov_positives} AS cov_positives,
    ${cov_total_tests} AS cov_total_tests,
    ${cov_tp} AS cov_tp,
     '${cov_tp_level}' AS cov_tp_level,
      ${flu_positives}  AS flu_positives,
     ${flu_total_tests} AS flu_total_tests,
   ${flu_tp} AS flu_tp,
   '${flu_tp_level}' AS flu_tp_level,
   ${rsv_positives}  AS rsv_positives,
   ${rsv_total_tests} AS rsv_total_tests,
    ${rsv_tp}  AS rsv_tp,
    '${rsv_tp_level}' AS rsv_tp_level,
   CAST(${cov_ed_visits} AS INT64) AS cov_ed_visits,
   CAST(${flu_ed_visits} AS INT64) AS flu_ed_visits,
   CAST(${rsv_ed_visits} AS INT64) AS rsv_ed_visits,
   CAST(${population} AS INT64) AS population,
   ${cov_adm}  AS cov_adm,
    ${flu_adm} AS flu_adm,
   ${rsv_adm} AS rsv_adm,
  ${cov_adm_rate}  AS cov_adm_rate,
    ${flu_adm_rate} AS flu_adm_rate,
   ${rsv_adm_rate} AS rsv_adm_rate,
   '${cov_adm_level}' AS cov_adm_level,
   '${flu_adm_level}' AS flu_adm_level,
   '${rsv_adm_level}'  AS rsv_adm_level,
  ${total_deaths} AS total_deaths,
  ${cov_deaths} AS cov_deaths,
   ${flu_deaths} AS flu_deaths,
  ${rsv_deaths} AS rsv_deaths,
  ${cov_deaths_per} AS cov_deaths_per,
  ${flu_deaths_per} AS flu_deaths_per,
  ${rsv_deaths_per}  AS rsv_deaths_per,
  ${season_cov_ped_deaths}  AS season_cov_ped_deaths,
${season_flu_ped_deaths}  AS season_flu_ped_deaths,
${season_rsv_ped_deaths}  AS season_rsv_ped_deaths,
    ${flu_a_tests} AS flu_a_tests,
   ${flu_b_tests}  AS flu_b_tests
FROM `test-project-471918.DW.dim_date` AS d
JOIN `test-project-471918.DW.dim_season` AS s
  ON s.season_name = '${season}'
JOIN `test-project-471918.DW.dim_region` AS r
  ON r.rpho_region= '${region}'
JOIN `test-project-471918.DW.dim_age_group` AS a
  ON a.age_group_label= '${age_group}'
WHERE d.full_date=PARSE_DATE('%m/%d/%Y', '${weekending}');
